pages.transcription:
Hotel Wyndham Newyork
42 West 58 Street
Taft Hotel
Newhaven, Conn.                                Newyork, 4. April
                                              Newhaven, 23rd March 1941.

Dear Hanna,
        As you see from the letter which I wrote to my accountant
I will have to bother you with the task of compiling an income tax
statement for me. You will have to make a list of all my literary
income during the past taxation year. As to investments there are
1.) at the Westminster Bank as far as they have not yet been called
up for sale by order of the Treasury which they will know better than
I do, 2) at the New Trading Co. From all those investments income
tax will already have been deducted at the source. I suppose that
you have also received from Cassell the royalties for "Tide of For-
tune" and the other books, for which income tax will not have been
and there will deducted yet. I myself have not received a single letter from them
have been a since I am away and do not know anything about the sales. Should
small payment they not have sent you the statement you ought to claim statement
from Hungary and payment from them (as well as the author's copies of "Tide of
through Ant Fortune" to which I am entitled).
chiron or        I am very sorry that I have to give you all this trouble.
Tabori You know that it was my intention to be back long before to do it all
myself, but God knows when we shall see each other and I would not
like to delay fulfilling my duties in due time.
        Also do not forget to declare the income from Lotte's
investments which are at Layton's and from whom you doubtless re-
ceived regular statements.
        We shall see Eva next week here in Newyork
and will write you soon. We have so much to do with
all plans and preparations for the next months that
I can send only the kindest regards and our love

                                              StefanZweig

There has been much loss of mail as I read in
the papers. Please confirm this letter by cable
To the Accountant I did send the letter 1/ by
air mail and 2/ by ordinary mail, because I want to
keep my things in order as far as it is possible in this nomadic life
